title: Vanilla Enhanced
description: Modpack for better experience in Minecraft Vanilla
body:
A lightweight modpack designed to enhance the Vanilla experience without losing its essence. It adds improvements to gameplay, quality of life, optimization, and small details that enrich classic Minecraft. Perfect for those who enjoy the original style but want an extra touch of freshness and comfort.

- Subtle visual improvements.
  
- Performance and optimization mods.
  
- Quality of life features (maps, etc.).
  
- Mechanics that expand vanilla without breaking it.
